title: After an app update, the first opening waits for one-time repair jobs before showing anything
what: On the first start after an update, the app finishes several one-time clean-ups (fixing old records, fixing imported workout times, fixing copied routines, adding new library exercises) one after another before the first screen appears. Each one says it never holds up start-up, but each is waited for. On a phone with years of workouts, the record fix rebuilds every affected exercise in turn, so that first opening can sit on the loading screen. Later starts are quick because each job remembers it is done.
expected: The first screen appears straight away; one-time clean-ups run just after it, like the lighter-set record fix already does.
fix_line: Start the one-time clean-ups after the first screen shows, the same way the lighter-set fix is delayed

items.reason: phone app data and start-up code; no panel web pages in this area (pagespeed.json covers the panel and websites)
no watch code in this area; nothing here keeps the screen on or runs timers in the background
